text: 庭院深深深几许，杨柳堆烟，帘幕无重数
pinyin: tíng yuàn shēn shēn shēn jǐ xǔ, yáng liǔ duī yān, lián mù wú chóng shù
literal: courtyard · deep · deep · deep · how · much, willows · pile · mist, curtains · no · layers · count
natural: How deep, how very deep is the courtyard? Willows heap up like mist and the curtains are past counting

meaning.en: Evokes a secluded, deep-set household and the loneliness of a woman shut inside.
meaning.zh: 形容庭院幽深，帘幕重重，暗含深闺女子的寂寞与幽怨。

equivalents: a mansion of endless depths

examples.zh: 走进老宅，他想起了“庭院深深深几许，杨柳堆烟，帘幕无重数”。
examples.en: Walking into the old mansion he thought of this line.

examples.zh: 导游用“庭院深深深几许，杨柳堆烟，帘幕无重数”来形容这座园林的幽深。
examples.en: The guide used this line to describe the garden's seclusion.

origin.source: 欧阳修《蝶恋花·庭院深深深几许》

story.en: A lyric in the voice of a woman in a deep courtyard whose husband is away in the pleasure quarters; the opening line is famous for its repeated 深. (Some sources attribute the lyric to Feng Yansi.)
story.zh: 此词写深闺女子的幽怨，开篇三个“深”字叠用最为人称道。（一说为冯延巳所作。）

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 泪眼问花花不语，乱红飞过秋千去
pinyin: lèi yǎn wèn huā huā bù yǔ, luàn hóng fēi guò qiū qiān qù
literal: tearful · eyes · ask · flowers · flowers · not · speak, scattered · red · fly · past · swing · go
natural: With tearful eyes I ask the flowers, but they do not answer; falling blossoms fly past the swing

meaning.en: A sorrowing person asks the flowers for sympathy and gets only silence as petals scatter.
meaning.zh: 含泪向花倾诉，花却无言，只见落红飞过秋千，写尽无人理解的伤春之情。

equivalents: pouring one's heart out to silent flowers

examples.zh: 暮春的院子里，她呆呆望着落花，正是“泪眼问花花不语，乱红飞过秋千去”。
examples.en: In the courtyard in late spring she stares blankly at falling petals: this line exactly.

examples.zh: 这首词里最让人心碎的是“泪眼问花花不语，乱红飞过秋千去”。
examples.en: The most heartbreaking line in the lyric is this one.

origin.source: 欧阳修《蝶恋花·庭院深深深几许》

story.en: The closing lines of the same lyric: the lonely woman asks the blossoms about spring, and no answer comes.
story.zh: 同一首词的结尾：深闺女子含泪问花，花不言语，落红飞散。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 忧劳可以兴国，逸豫可以亡身
pinyin: yōu láo kě yǐ xīng guó, yì yù kě yǐ wáng shēn
literal: worry · toil · can · thereby · raise · state, ease · pleasure · can · thereby · ruin · self
natural: Anxious toil can make a state flourish; ease and indulgence can destroy oneself

meaning.en: Hard work and vigilance bring success, while complacency and pleasure-seeking lead to ruin.
meaning.zh: 忧虑勤劳能使国家兴盛，安逸享乐则会使自身灭亡。

equivalents: complacency breeds decline
work hard and prosper, slack off and perish

examples.zh: 公司创始人常用“忧劳可以兴国，逸豫可以亡身”提醒员工。
examples.en: The founder often reminds staff with this line.

examples.zh: 历史告诉我们“忧劳可以兴国，逸豫可以亡身”，居安思危才能长久。
examples.en: History tells us this: stay alert in times of peace to last long.

origin.source: 欧阳修《伶官传序》

story.en: Ouyang Xiu's preface to the Biographies of Court Entertainers in the New Book of Five Dynasties draws on the rise and fall of Li Cunxu to warn rulers.
story.zh: 欧阳修《新五代史·伶官传序》：以后唐庄宗李存勖由盛而衰为鉴，告诫统治者勤勉警醒。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎
pinyin: zhí shǒu xiāng kàn lèi yǎn, jìng wú yǔ níng yē
literal: hold · hand · mutually · look · tearful · eyes, actually · no · words · choke · sob
natural: Hand in hand we gaze at each other with tearful eyes, and find ourselves too choked to speak

meaning.en: The pain of parting: lovers or friends are so moved they cannot speak.
meaning.zh: 写离别时双方泪眼相对、悲咽难言的情景。

equivalents: too choked up to say goodbye

examples.zh: 机场送别，两人“执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎”。
examples.en: At the airport farewell the two of them were in just such a state: this line.

examples.zh: 电影里那场离别戏，演出了“执手相看泪眼，竟无语凝噎”的感觉。
examples.en: That farewell scene in the film captures the feeling of this line.

origin.source: 柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》

story.en: Liu Yong's farewell lyric, set at an evening pavilion by the river as he leaves the capital and his lover.
story.zh: 柳永《雨霖铃》：写词人离开京城与恋人在长亭晚别时的情景。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 多情自古伤离别，更那堪冷落清秋节
pinyin: duō qíng zì gǔ shāng lí bié, gèng nǎ kān lěng luò qīng qiū jié
literal: affectionate · since · ancient · grieve · parting, even more · how · bear · cold · desolate · clear · autumn · season
natural: Sentimental people have always grieved at parting; how much worse in the bleak, cold season of autumn

meaning.en: Parting has always hurt the tender-hearted, and an autumn farewell hurts most.
meaning.zh: 自古多情的人最伤离别，何况是在冷落凄清的秋天。

equivalents: parting is such sweet sorrow
autumn farewells weigh heavier

examples.zh: 秋天送走挚友，他想起“多情自古伤离别，更那堪冷落清秋节”。
examples.en: Seeing off a close friend in autumn, he thought of this line.

examples.zh: 毕业季的离愁，正如“多情自古伤离别，更那堪冷落清秋节”。
examples.en: The sadness of graduation season is just as this line says.

origin.source: 柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》

story.en: From Liu Yong's Yu Lin Ling, where the autumn setting deepens the sorrow of leaving.
story.zh: 出自柳永《雨霖铃》：以清秋冷落的景象烘托离别的哀伤。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 今宵酒醒何处？杨柳岸，晓风残月
pinyin: jīn xiāo jiǔ xǐng hé chù, yáng liǔ àn, xiǎo fēng cán yuè
literal: tonight · wine · sober · where? willow · bank, dawn · wind · waning · moon
natural: Where will I wake from my wine tonight? On a willow-lined bank, with the dawn wind and a waning moon

meaning.en: A famously evocative image of the loneliness of a traveller after parting.
meaning.zh: 以杨柳岸、晓风残月勾勒别后旅人的孤寂凄清。

equivalents: waking alone in the cold dawn after a farewell

examples.zh: 独自出差的清晨，他忽然想起“今宵酒醒何处？杨柳岸，晓风残月”。
examples.en: One early morning on a lone business trip he suddenly recalled this line.

examples.zh: 这句“今宵酒醒何处？杨柳岸，晓风残月”常被拿来形容离愁。
examples.en: This line is often used to describe the sorrow of parting.

origin.source: 柳永《雨霖铃·寒蝉凄切》

story.en: Liu Yong imagines the morning after his departure: waking from drink on a riverbank under the setting moon.
story.zh: 柳永设想别后酒醒：孤身泊于岸边，只见晓风残月，凄凉无限。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 至今思项羽，不肯过江东
pinyin: zhì jīn sī xiàng yǔ, bù kěn guò jiāng dōng
literal: until · now · think of · Xiang Yu, not · willing · cross · river · east
natural: Even now we remember Xiang Yu, who would not cross to the east of the river

meaning.en: Admiration for a hero who preferred death to retreat in disgrace; also a veiled rebuke of the Song court's flight south.
meaning.zh: 赞颂项羽宁死不愿苟且偷生；也暗讽南宋朝廷南逃偷安。

equivalents: death before dishonour

examples.zh: 读到“至今思项羽，不肯过江东”，我对项羽有了新的敬意。
examples.en: Reading this line gave me a new respect for Xiang Yu.

examples.zh: 她引用“至今思项羽，不肯过江东”表达宁折不弯的气节。
examples.en: She quoted this line to express her unbending integrity.

origin.source: 李清照《夏日绝句》

story.en: Li Qingzhao, living through the Song court's retreat south, praised Xiang Yu, who killed himself at the Wu River rather than return in defeat to Jiangdong.
story.zh: 李清照身处南宋偏安之时，借项羽乌江自刎、不肯过江东一事，讽刺朝廷苟且偷生。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦
pinyin: zhī fǒu, zhī fǒu, yīng shì lǜ féi hóng shòu
literal: know · not, know · not? surely · is · green · plump · red · thin
natural: Do you know, do you know? It must be that the green leaves are lush and the red blossoms thin

meaning.en: Late spring: the leaves flourish while the flowers fade.
meaning.zh: 写暮春时节，绿叶繁茂而红花凋零。

equivalents: green leaves flourish as the blossoms fade

examples.zh: 初夏时分，窗外正是“知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦”。
examples.en: In early summer outside the window it is just as this line says.

examples.zh: 他用“知否，知否？应是绿肥红瘦”描写雨后的花园。
examples.en: He used this line to describe the garden after rain.

origin.source: 李清照《如梦令·昨夜雨疏风骤》

story.en: After a night of rain and wind, the poet asks the maid about the crabapple blossoms; the maid says they are unchanged, and Li replies with this line.
story.zh: 昨夜雨疏风骤，词人问卷帘的侍女海棠如何，侍女答“依旧”，词人以此句反驳。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 红藕香残玉簟秋，轻解罗裳，独上兰舟
pinyin: hóng ǒu xiāng cán yù diàn qiū, qīng jiě luó cháng, dú shàng lán zhōu
literal: red · lotus · fragrance · fading · jade · mat · autumn, lightly · loosen · silk · skirt, alone · board · orchid · boat
natural: The red lotus has lost its scent and the jade mat feels autumnal; I loosen my silk skirt and board an orchid boat alone

meaning.en: A lonely, lovelorn image from a woman missing her husband.
meaning.zh: 写独处闺中、思念丈夫的女子孤寂的心境。

equivalents: lonely autumn longing

examples.zh: 读到“红藕香残玉簟秋，轻解罗裳，独上兰舟”，我仿佛看到了词人的孤独。
examples.en: Reading this line I seem to see the poet's loneliness.

examples.zh: 这篇文章用“红藕香残玉簟秋，轻解罗裳，独上兰舟”开头，意境很美。
examples.en: The article opens with this line, with a beautiful mood.

origin.source: 李清照《一剪梅·红藕香残玉簟秋》

story.en: Written while Li Qingzhao's husband Zhao Mingcheng was away; she boards a boat alone and sends a silk letter into the sky.
story.zh: 李清照与丈夫赵明诚离别后所作，写独自泛舟、思念远人之情。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 花自飘零水自流。一种相思，两处闲愁
pinyin: huā zì piāo líng shuǐ zì liú, yī zhǒng xiāng sī, liǎng chù xián chóu
literal: flowers · by themselves · drift · fall · water · by itself · flows, one · kind · longing, two · places · idle · sorrow
natural: Flowers drift and fall by themselves, water flows by itself; one kind of longing, sorrow in two places

meaning.en: Two people apart feel the same longing, each sorrowing alone.
meaning.zh: 两个人相隔两地，同怀一种相思，各自忧愁。

equivalents: missing each other from afar

examples.zh: 异地的夫妻互发微信，“花自飘零水自流。一种相思，两处闲愁”。
examples.en: The long-distance couple message each other, one longing in two places: this line.

examples.zh: 情人节卡片上写着“花自飘零水自流。一种相思，两处闲愁”。
examples.en: The Valentine's card reads this line.

origin.source: 李清照《一剪梅·红藕香残玉簟秋》

story.en: From the same lyric: the poet imagines her husband far away feeling just as she does.
story.zh: 同一首词中：词人设想远方的丈夫与自己同怀相思。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 此情无计可消除，才下眉头，却上心头
pinyin: cǐ qíng wú jì kě xiāo chú, cái xià méi tóu, què shàng xīn tóu
literal: this · feeling · no · means · can · remove, just · descend · brow · head, yet · rise · heart · head
natural: There is no way to dispel this feeling: it has just left my brow, only to settle in my heart

meaning.en: Longing that cannot be shaken off; hidden from the face, it only sinks deeper.
meaning.zh: 相思之情无法排遣，刚从眉间消去，又涌上心头。

equivalents: can't shake the feeling

examples.zh: 他想忘记那段感情，却“此情无计可消除，才下眉头，却上心头”。
examples.en: He wanted to forget that romance but found this line true.

examples.zh: 歌词里化用了“此情无计可消除，才下眉头，却上心头”。
examples.en: The lyrics adapt this line.

origin.source: 李清照《一剪梅·红藕香残玉簟秋》

story.en: The closing lines of the lyric, expressing longing that no effort can remove.
story.zh: 同一首词的结句，写相思无法排遣。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 只恐双溪舴艋舟，载不动许多愁
pinyin: zhǐ kǒng shuāng xī zé měng zhōu, zài bù dòng xǔ duō chóu
literal: only · fear · Shuangxi · grasshopper · boat, carry · not · move · so · much · sorrow
natural: I fear that the tiny boat on the Shuangxi could not carry so much sorrow

meaning.en: Sorrow so heavy that even a boat would be unable to bear it.
meaning.zh: 愁绪深重，连小船也载不动。

equivalents: a weight of sorrow too heavy to bear

examples.zh: 他心事重重，真是“只恐双溪舴艋舟，载不动许多愁”。
examples.en: His heart is heavy with cares: this line exactly.

examples.zh: 这句“只恐双溪舴艋舟，载不动许多愁”把愁写得有了重量。
examples.en: This line gives sorrow weight.

origin.source: 李清照《武陵春·风住尘香花已尽》

story.en: Late in life, after the fall of the north and her husband's death, Li Qingzhao thought of a boat trip at Shuangxi in Jinhua but feared it could not bear her grief.
story.zh: 李清照晚年经历国破夫亡，想泛舟金华双溪排遣，又担心小舟载不动自己的愁。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 小楼昨夜又东风，故国不堪回首月明中
pinyin: xiǎo lóu zuó yè yòu dōng fēng, gù guó bù kān huí shǒu yuè míng zhōng
literal: small · tower · last · night · again · east · wind, old · country · cannot · bear · turn · head · moon · bright · in
natural: Last night the east wind blew again at my little tower; I cannot bear to look back at my homeland in the bright moonlight

meaning.en: The pain of remembering a lost homeland.
meaning.zh: 表达对故国的深切怀念与亡国之痛。

equivalents: unbearable memories of a lost homeland

examples.zh: 华侨老人望着月亮，心中满是“小楼昨夜又东风，故国不堪回首月明中”的伤感。
examples.en: The old overseas Chinese gazes at the moon, filled with the sorrow of this line.

examples.zh: 这句“小楼昨夜又东风，故国不堪回首月明中”传说是李煜被毒死的原因之一。
examples.en: This line is said to be one reason Li Yu was poisoned.

origin.source: 李煜《虞美人·春花秋月何时了》

story.en: Li Yu, the last ruler of Southern Tang, wrote it as a captive of the Song; legend says the song angered Emperor Taizong and led to his death.
story.zh: 南唐后主李煜被俘后所作；传说宋太宗闻此词而不悦，赐毒酒将其害死。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 雕栏玉砌应犹在，只是朱颜改
pinyin: diāo lán yù qì yīng yóu zài, zhǐ shì zhū yán gǎi
literal: carved · railings · jade · steps · surely · still · remain, only · rosy · faces · changed
natural: The carved railings and jade steps must still be there; only the rosy faces have changed

meaning.en: Things remain but people have changed or gone; also a lament for lost youth.
meaning.zh: 景物依旧而人事已非，也感叹青春易逝。

equivalents: the place is the same, but the people have changed

examples.zh: 回到母校，看着旧楼，他想到“雕栏玉砌应犹在，只是朱颜改”。
examples.en: Back at his old school, looking at the old building, he thought of this line.

examples.zh: 老街坊重逢时，大家感叹“雕栏玉砌应犹在，只是朱颜改”。
examples.en: When old neighbours reunited, everyone sighed this line.

origin.source: 李煜《虞美人·春花秋月何时了》

story.en: From the same lyric: Li Yu imagines his old palace in Jinling, intact but with its people gone.
story.zh: 同一首词：李煜想象金陵故宫依旧，却已人事全非。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 独自莫凭阑，无限江山，别时容易见时难
pinyin: dú zì mò píng lán, wú xiàn jiāng shān, bié shí róng yì jiàn shí nán
literal: alone · don't · lean · on rail, boundless · rivers · hills, parting · time · easy · meeting · time · hard
natural: Do not lean on the railing alone, for the boundless rivers and mountains were easy to leave and are hard to see again

meaning.en: Parting is easy but meeting again is hard.
meaning.zh: 离别容易，再见却很难。

equivalents: easy to part, hard to meet again

examples.zh: 毕业时，同学们互相写下“独自莫凭阑，无限江山，别时容易见时难”。
examples.en: At graduation classmates wrote this line to each other.

examples.zh: 车站送别，他低声说“独自莫凭阑，无限江山，别时容易见时难”。
examples.en: At the station farewell he whispered this line.

origin.source: 李煜《浪淘沙·帘外雨潺潺》

story.en: One of Li Yu's last lyrics, written in captivity as he looked out over the lost kingdom.
story.zh: 李煜被囚后期的作品，凭栏远望，追思故国江山。

date.zh: 南唐亡后 · 北宋 · 约977—978年
date.en: after the fall of Southern Tang, Northern Song, c. 977–978

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 落花人独立，微雨燕双飞
pinyin: luò huā rén dú lì, wēi yǔ yàn shuāng fēi
literal: falling · flowers · person · alone · stand, fine · rain · swallows · pair · fly
natural: Among falling blossoms I stand alone; in the fine rain a pair of swallows flies

meaning.en: The lonely contrasted with the paired: a solitary person watches swallows flying together.
meaning.zh: 以双燕对独立之人，突出孤单与思念。

equivalents: alone while others come in pairs

examples.zh: 情人节，他一个人走在路上，“落花人独立，微雨燕双飞”。
examples.en: On Valentine's Day he walked alone, this line exactly.

examples.zh: 这句“落花人独立，微雨燕双飞”意境优美，常被引用。
examples.en: This line is beautifully evocative and often quoted.

origin.source: 晏几道《临江仙·梦后楼台高锁》

story.en: Yan Jidao recalls a singing girl, Xiaopin, after the party has ended; the line was also written earlier by Weng Hong, and Yan's use is the better known.
story.zh: 晏几道追忆歌女小蘋；此句翁宏《春残》中已有，但经晏几道化用而更为人知。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 当时明月在，曾照彩云归
pinyin: dāng shí míng yuè zài, céng zhào cǎi yún guī
literal: that · time · bright · moon · exists, once · lit · coloured · cloud · return
natural: The bright moon of that time is still here; it once lit the beautiful girl, a coloured cloud, going home

meaning.en: The moon remains, but the beloved one it once lit is gone.
meaning.zh: 明月依旧，当年相伴的佳人却已远去。

equivalents: the moon remains but she is gone

examples.zh: 旧地重游，他想起“当时明月在，曾照彩云归”。
examples.en: Revisiting the old place, he recalled this line.

examples.zh: “当时明月在，曾照彩云归”写出了物是人非的怅惘。
examples.en: This line expresses the sadness of things unchanged and people gone.

origin.source: 晏几道《临江仙·梦后楼台高锁》

story.en: The closing lines of the lyric: the moon that once lit Xiaopin home is still shining, but she is gone; 彩云 is a poetic image for the girl.
story.zh: 该词结句：当年照着小蘋归去的明月犹在，人已不见；“彩云”喻佳人。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 舞低杨柳楼心月，歌尽桃花扇底风
pinyin: wǔ dī yáng liǔ lóu xīn yuè, gē jìn táo huā shàn dǐ fēng
literal: dance · lower · willow · tower · heart · moon, song · exhaust · peach · blossom · fan · under · breeze
natural: She danced until the moon sank to the willow-tops from the tower's heart, and sang until no breeze was left beneath her peach-blossom fan

meaning.en: Describes a night of song and dance carried on until the moon sets.
meaning.zh: 形容歌舞通宵达旦、欢乐尽兴的场面。

equivalents: dancing and singing the night away

examples.zh: 晚会跳到深夜，真是“舞低杨柳楼心月，歌尽桃花扇底风”。
examples.en: The party danced late into the night, just like this line.

examples.zh: 他用“舞低杨柳楼心月，歌尽桃花扇底风”形容戏曲演出的盛况。
examples.en: He used this line to describe a lively opera performance.

origin.source: 晏几道《鹧鸪天·彩袖殷勤捧玉钟》

story.en: Yan Jidao remembers a lively banquet where a girl sang and danced all night, and a reunion that now feels like a dream.
story.zh: 晏几道追忆当年筵席：歌女彻夜歌舞，如今重逢恍如梦中。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 金风玉露一相逢，便胜却人间无数
pinyin: jīn fēng yù lù yī xiāng féng, biàn shèng què rén jiān wú shù
literal: golden · wind · jade · dew · once · meet, then · surpass · human · world · countless
natural: When the autumn wind meets the dew, a single meeting outweighs countless ones in the human world

meaning.en: A true meeting of loving hearts, even rare, is worth more than endless ordinary togetherness.
meaning.zh: 真心相爱的人哪怕难得相见，一次相逢也胜过世间无数平庸的相聚。

equivalents: quality over quantity in love

examples.zh: 七夕节，情侣们互发“金风玉露一相逢，便胜却人间无数”。
examples.en: On Qixi couples send each other this line.

examples.zh: 异地恋的他们，对“金风玉露一相逢，便胜却人间无数”特别有感触。
examples.en: The long-distance couple feel this line especially deeply.

origin.source: 秦观《鹊桥仙·纤云弄巧》

story.en: Qin Guan's Qixi lyric on the Cowherd and Weaver Girl, who meet once a year on a bridge of magpies.
story.zh: 秦观七夕词，写牛郎织女一年一度鹊桥相会。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 自在飞花轻似梦，无边丝雨细如愁
pinyin: zì zài fēi huā qīng sì mèng, wú biān sī yǔ xì rú chóu
literal: free · flying · blossoms · light · like · dream, boundless · silken · rain · fine · like · sorrow
natural: Freely drifting blossoms are light as a dream; endless threads of rain are fine as sorrow

meaning.en: Images of drifting petals and fine drizzle that mirror a faint, lingering melancholy.
meaning.zh: 以飞花、丝雨比喻轻而无形、绵绵不绝的愁绪。

equivalents: light as a dream, fine as sorrow

examples.zh: 细雨中的校园，让人想起“自在飞花轻似梦，无边丝雨细如愁”。
examples.en: The campus in the drizzle reminds one of this line.

examples.zh: 他把“自在飞花轻似梦，无边丝雨细如愁”写在了笔记本扉页。
examples.en: He wrote this line on the flyleaf of his notebook.

origin.source: 秦观《浣溪沙·漠漠轻寒上小楼》

story.en: A lyric of late spring by Qin Guan, describing a woman alone in her tower on a chilly, rainy morning.
story.zh: 秦观暮春词，写女子独上小楼、轻寒细雨中的闲愁。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 试问闲愁都几许？一川烟草，满城风絮，梅子黄时雨
pinyin: shì wèn xián chóu dōu jǐ xǔ, yī chuān yān cǎo, mǎn chéng fēng xù, méi zǐ huáng shí yǔ
literal: try · ask · idle · sorrow · altogether · how · much? one · plain · misty · grass, full · city · wind · catkins, plum · ripe · yellow · time · rain
natural: How much idle sorrow do I have? A misty plain of grass, a city full of drifting catkins, and the rains of the plum season

meaning.en: Uses three images to make an invisible sorrow concrete: it is as endless as mist, catkins and rain.
meaning.zh: 以烟草、风絮、梅雨三种景象形容愁绪的多而绵长。

equivalents: sorrow as boundless as mist, catkins and rain

examples.zh: 这句“试问闲愁都几许？一川烟草，满城风絮，梅子黄时雨”被称为“贺梅子”的由来。
examples.en: This line gave He Zhu his nickname 'Plum He'.

examples.zh: 他写愁绪，借用了“试问闲愁都几许？一川烟草，满城风絮，梅子黄时雨”。
examples.en: He borrowed this line to write about sorrow.

origin.source: 贺铸《青玉案·凌波不过横塘路》

story.en: He Zhu wrote it after seeing a beauty pass by near Hengtang and failing to meet her; the closing triple metaphor made him known as 'Plum He' (贺梅子).
story.zh: 贺铸见佳人经过横塘而不得相见，以三重比喻写愁，因此被称为“贺梅子”。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 桃李春风一杯酒，江湖夜雨十年灯
pinyin: táo lǐ chūn fēng yī bēi jiǔ, jiāng hú yè yǔ shí nián dēng
literal: peach · plum · spring · wind · one · cup · wine, rivers · lakes · night · rain · ten · years · lamp
natural: Peach and plum blossoms in the spring breeze, one cup of wine; rivers and lakes, night rain, ten years by a lamp

meaning.en: Remembers an old friend: one happy drink in spring, followed by ten years of lonely wandering.
meaning.zh: 回忆与老友春日共饮的快乐，再对比十年漂泊、夜雨孤灯的寂寞。

equivalents: one happy drink, ten lonely years

examples.zh: 老同学十年没见，他想起“桃李春风一杯酒，江湖夜雨十年灯”。
examples.en: He hadn't seen his old classmate for ten years and thought of this line.

examples.zh: “桃李春风一杯酒，江湖夜雨十年灯”两句对仗工整，意境深远。
examples.en: The two halves of this line are perfectly balanced, with deep feeling.

origin.source: 黄庭坚《寄黄几复》

story.en: Huang Tingjian wrote it for his old friend Huang Jifu, posted far away on the south coast, recalling their past companionship.
story.zh: 黄庭坚寄赠远在广东四会的老友黄几复，回忆往日同游共饮，叹别后十年相隔。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 少年易老学难成，一寸光阴不可轻
pinyin: shào nián yì lǎo xué nán chéng, yī cùn guāng yīn bù kě qīng
literal: youth · easily · grow old · learning · hard · to complete, one · inch · time · not · may · take lightly
natural: Youth fades easily and learning is hard to complete, so do not take a single inch of time lightly

meaning.en: Cherish every moment of your youth to study, because time passes quickly and learning takes long.
meaning.zh: 青春易逝而学问难成，所以要珍惜每一寸光阴。

equivalents: time and tide wait for no man
make every moment count

examples.zh: 班主任把“少年易老学难成，一寸光阴不可轻”写在黑板上。
examples.en: The class teacher wrote this line on the blackboard.

examples.zh: 临近考试，他才懂得“少年易老学难成，一寸光阴不可轻”。
examples.en: With exams near, he finally understood this line.

origin.source: 朱熹《偶成》

story.en: Traditionally attributed to Zhu Xi as 'Casual Poem' and long used in primers; its authorship is debated, but it has circulated under his name for centuries.
story.zh: 传统上题为朱熹《偶成》，长期用于蒙学读物；作者归属有争议，但流传极广。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春
pinyin: děng xián shí dé dōng fēng miàn, wàn zǐ qiān hóng zǒng shì chūn
literal: easily · recognise · east · wind · face, ten thousand · purple · thousand · red · always · is · spring
natural: Easily one recognises the face of the east wind: the countless purples and reds are all spring

meaning.en: The vibrant colours everywhere are the face of spring; also a symbol of flourishing and variety.
meaning.zh: 到处姹紫嫣红就是春天的面貌，也比喻百花齐放、欣欣向荣。

equivalents: a riot of colour in spring
a hundred flowers blooming

examples.zh: 春游路上，满眼是“等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春”。
examples.en: On the spring outing everywhere we looked was this line.

examples.zh: 文艺繁荣的局面，可谓“等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春”。
examples.en: The flourishing of the arts could be called this line.

origin.source: 朱熹《春日》

story.en: Zhu Xi's spring poem is said to be an allegory for finding the Way of Confucius, whose abundant colours are the face of spring.
story.zh: 朱熹《春日》表面写春游，一般认为暗喻求得圣道后见万象皆春。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 儿童急走追黄蝶，飞入菜花无处寻
pinyin: ér tóng jí zǒu zhuī huáng dié, fēi rù cài huā wú chù xún
literal: children · hurry · run · chase · yellow · butterfly, fly · into · rape · flowers · nowhere · to find
natural: Children dash after a yellow butterfly, which flies into the rape flowers and cannot be found

meaning.en: A playful rural scene of children chasing a butterfly lost among the yellow flowers.
meaning.zh: 写孩子们追赶黄蝶、蝶入油菜花丛不见踪影的童趣。

equivalents: chasing butterflies in a field of flowers

examples.zh: 春天的田野里，孩子们追蝶，正是“儿童急走追黄蝶，飞入菜花无处寻”。
examples.en: In the spring fields, children chasing butterflies are just like this line.

examples.zh: 语文课本里的“儿童急走追黄蝶，飞入菜花无处寻”很有画面感。
examples.en: This line in the textbook is very visual.

origin.source: 杨万里《宿新市徐公店》

story.en: Yang Wanli wrote it while staying at Mr Xu's inn at Xinshi, describing the village hedges, the children and the rape-flower fields.
story.zh: 杨万里投宿新市徐公店时所作，描写篱落、儿童与菜花田野的春景。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。
